document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your party’s misgivings are contagious, and your inspirational 
talk falls on discouraged ears. You call an expedition meeting, 
and it decides the best thing to do is to build a raft and drift 
back downriver to civilization.
